verdict.rationale: Lever documents an onboarding module with automation for verification, forms, and tax documents, plus a general marketplace for integrations connecting the 'hiring stack,' but there is no explicit evidence of a signed-offer-to-onboarding handoff or named HRIS/payroll integrations that transfer new-hire data without re-entry. Missing for 10: explicit HRIS/payroll integration documentation, data-mapping/field-sync specifics, and confirmation that offer data flows automatically into onboarding without manual re-entry.
